title: Third Place
tagline: A neighborhood café with no purchase required.
blurb: Zoning sagas, funding trials, and an honest membership post-mortem.
desc: Public space is disappearing into commercial space. Third Place is a working model for a neighborhood room that asks nothing of you — funded, zoned, and staffed in the open so other neighborhoods can fork the playbook.
The page's value is the orchestration record: three funding models tried, the zoning saga documented decision by decision, and an honest post-mortem on the membership experiment.

commits.msg: Drop membership model — creates the exclusion we exist to remove
